name: Employee Import / 员工归集
description: 从 Futu 授予明细与 Shareworks 明细提取员工，各自规范成 (employee_id, source, employee_name) 后 union，再按 employee_id UPSERT 进 employees 表。换文件重跑即幂等重归集；跨来源同人由「关联」处理。

tasks.name: Extract Futu 授予记录

fileRef.$label: Futu 授予数据导出报表 workbook

tasks.description: 从 Futu 授予数据导出报表的「授予记录」sheet 提取明细（含 工号、姓名）。

tasks.name: Extract Shareworks Options OS Detail
tasks.description: 从 Shareworks Cap Table 的「Options OS Detail」sheet 提取明细（表头在第 2 行）。

tasks.name: Normalize Futu Employees

params.sql:
select distinct
  upper(trim(concat('', coalesce([工号], '')))) as employee_id,
  'futu' as source,
  trim(concat('', coalesce([姓名], ''))) as employee_name,
  true as has_file_evidence
from {futu}
where trim(concat('', coalesce([工号], ''))) <> ''

tasks.description: 把 Futu 明细去重规范成 (employee_id, source, employee_name)。

tasks.name: Filter Shareworks Employee Rows
tasks.description: 过滤 Shareworks Options OS Detail 中计划级占位行，例如 BC Subplan 这类不是员工的记录。

tasks.name: Normalize Shareworks Employees

params.sql:
select distinct
  upper(trim(concat('', coalesce([Employee Number], '')))) as employee_id,
  'shareworks' as source,
  trim(concat(coalesce([First Name], ''), ' ', coalesce([Middle Name], ''), ' ', coalesce([Last Name], ''))) as employee_name,
  true as has_file_evidence
from {sw}
where trim(concat('', coalesce([Employee Number], ''))) <> ''

tasks.description: 把 Shareworks 明细去重规范成 (employee_id, source, employee_name)，姓名由 last/first/middle 拼成。

tasks.name: Union Employees
tasks.description: 把 Futu 与 Shareworks 员工按列名对齐后合并成一张待写入表。

tasks.name: Upsert Employees
tasks.description: 按 employee_id UPSERT 进 employees 表：已存在工号更新姓名/证据，新工号插入。
